## Triage verdict

**Dedupe.** The testing-seed family relocated as a set, and each sibling owns exactly one part: #1953 the seed store + collector (was #122), #1956 the generator engine choice (was #123), #1958 the generator registry/versioning (was #124), and **#1960 the landing** (was #125), whose own summary reads: "execute #121–#124 in the smallest useful slice… the seed helper + wrapper + first generator landed". #1960 already carries `queue/queued` — a task for it is in the queue. This issue is the design/decision record for the seed itself (format, derivation, transport), the same relationship #1601 (design) has to its phase issues. Enqueueing a fresh implementation packet from here would duplicate #1960 deliverable 2, so none is enqueued.

**Scope confirmed on current main (`c58507a`, 2026-10-29):**
- No `MCPX_TEST_SEED` anywhere in the repo (grep across Go/YAML/shell: no hits) — the channel does not exist yet.
- No seed helper: `internal/testsupport/` exists (fake MCP servers, temp dirs) but has no `seed` package.
- CI still calls `go test` directly with no seed job (`.github/workflows/mcpx.yml:119`), exactly as the issue's current-state table says.
- The issue's "clean slate" claim is now *slightly* stale — a small number of tests reference randomness-adjacent helpers (e.g. `internal/daemon/handoff_conns_test.go`, `internal/e2e/keepalive_takeover_test.go`) — which strengthens rather than weakens the case: #1960's inventory deliverable should classify them, and the seed helper should land before randomized tests multiply, per the strategy's step-1 reasoning.

**Decision record (for #1960's pass):** the issue's recommendations stand as the spec — UUIDv7 minted only by the wrapper/CI, arbitrary seed strings accepted on input; SHA-256 domain-separated derivation (`mcpx-test-seed/v1`) with per-test, per-generator streams into ChaCha8; generators draw only `Uint64()`; `MCPX_TEST_SEED` as the single channel; lazy `internal/testsupport/seed` helper; fail-closed in CI when unset; no static default ever. The open questions (wrapper home — just vs script vs both; the `MCPX_TEST_*` allowlist entry owed to the settings guard; shuffle-by-default locally) are implementation-time choices for #1960, with the issue's proposed defaults as the starting position; none of them blocks starting.

**State after triage:** this issue stays open as the design record until #1960 lands the helper + wrapper + CI seed job, at which point it can close with a link to that PR. Claim labels removed; no `queue/*` label is set because no queue task exists for this issue itself — the live task is #1960's.

agent-note:v1
state: triaged
Verdict: **still live — keep open.** This is the seed decision record; its spec is now half-landed, and the half that is missing is the transport (channel + wrapper + fail-closed CI). Triaged at `origin/main` `a8dbda7fc` on 2026-11-03 (queue task 7807). No new task enqueued: the landing is still owned by #1960, which has a queued triage task of its own (7799).

**What changed since the 2026-10-29 triage (task 2845):**

| Item | Then | Now |
|---|---|---|
| Generator engine (#1956) | open | **closed**; `pkgs/mcpx/internal/testsupport/gen` exists on main with the §2 v1 derivation — `SHA-256("mcpx-test-seed/v1\x00" ‖ seedID)` root, per-test/per-generator ChaCha8 stream keys (`gen/gen.go:17-51`) |
| Registry / bug-shape generators (#1958) | open | **closed** |
| Seed store + collector (#1953) | open | **closed** |
| #1960 deliverable 1 (test inventory) | queued | **merged** — PR #2643, 2026-10-30 |
| `MCPX_TEST_SEED` channel | absent | **still absent** — zero hits repo-wide (Go/YAML/shell/justfile) |
| Test wrapper (`just mcpx-test` / `scripts/test.sh`) | absent | **still absent** — no mcpx recipe in `justfile`, no `pkgs/mcpx/scripts/test.sh` |
| Fail-closed CI on an unset seed | absent | **still absent** — `.github/workflows/mcpx.yml:195` runs bare `go test ./... -count=1` |

So the "clean slate" premise in the body is obsolete in the good direction: the derivation contract is implemented and tested; only the plumbing that mints/transports the seed is left.

**New finding worth carrying into #1960 (not recorded before):** CI **already** mints a deterministic per-run seed — `.github/workflows/mcpx.yml:463` and `:529` derive an integer from `SHA-256("mcpx-shuffle/v1:" + RUN_IDENTITY)` and pass it to `-shuffle`. That is the same shape as this issue's recommendation, but it is a *second, independent* seed: nothing feeds test inputs, and `RUN_IDENTITY` is duplicated across the PR-stress and nightly jobs. When the channel lands, mint `MCPX_TEST_SEED` once from `RUN_IDENTITY` (commit it to a job output / `$GITHUB_ENV`) and derive the `-shuffle` integer from the run seed's stream, otherwise the "one seed per run" requirement is violated at exactly the place it matters (the full-suite job).

**Remaining scope, all inside #1960 deliverable 2:** one wrapper that mints a UUIDv7 when unset and writes it back; `MCPX_TEST_SEED` as the single env channel (accepted by the settings allowlist so the "read but never declared" guard treats it as test-only); shuffle seed derived from the run seed; fail-closed in CI when unset; no static default. The issue's own open questions (wrapper home, local seeds in the store, shuffle-on-by-default locally, var name, v7-only vs arbitrary ids, budget knob) remain implementation-time choices for #1960 — none blocks starting, and the proposed defaults in this body stand.

**Ordering:** #1949 closes when the seed channel + wrapper are on main and CI fails closed without a seed — i.e. when #1960 deliverable 2 lands, not before. Nothing here needs Drew.

**Coverage check:** live queue tasks exist for the only other open members of this family — #1960 (task 7799 queued) and tracker #1896. No orphan.
